drafted_by: template-drafter-v4 (deterministic program; up to max_per_family queries per family, each from a distinct effective template; opaque ids)

selection_criteria.pool: A: unused development families never used in the 300-case synthetic policy-development check (bera.evalkit.batchplan)
selection_criteria.family_priority: diversity first: 20 distinct families; more queries per family in later batches
selection_criteria.within_family: distinct templates; every op changes the query; editions may differ
selection_criteria.excluded: families with any prior draft, families of discussed cases, previously seen queries, prior source/gold editions
selection_criteria.never_used_for_selection: drafted proposals, system outputs or scores

note: Ids are opaque and the order is random. Before the whole batch is labeled, no template, template note, proposal, agreement or score is sent. The proposal is a program draft, not ground truth. Composition by template or proposed outcome is deliberately not summarized here.
